name: History Hero with extendable WSD training
user_decision: Use warmup-stable-decay so training can be extended.
scope: Record the selected schedule for the history continuation. This is not a frozen launch specification or authorization for additional compute.

parent.transition: Explicit child experiment retaining model and optimizer state, counters and RNG semantics. Do not mutate the historical checkpoint or describe a changed schedule/data contract as an exact HH-002 resume.

selected_schedule.warmup_policy: Preserve the original absolute warmup and accumulated example count. Do not repeat or rescale warmup when extending training.
selected_schedule.stable_policy: Continue at the fixed peak rates; retain a full recovery state before entering any cooldown.
selected_schedule.cooldown_policy: Create an explicitly identified evaluation branch from a stable checkpoint; its cooldown duration is fixed before running that branch.
selected_schedule.extension_policy: Resume the retained stable checkpoint and postpone the next cooldown. Do not raise LR on a cooled checkpoint and call it the same stable continuation. Cooldown work is branch-specific and may need repeating for each evaluated horizon.
selected_schedule.other_recipe_settings: Keep the HH-002 Hero architecture, objectives, optimizer moments/storage and weight-decay settings unchanged. Do not select hero_v2 merely to enable WSD. Precision/compilation changes require a separately validated and recorded decision.

proposed_first_cooldown_not_frozen.note: Illustrative 2% warmup / 78% stable / 20% cooldown, pending the audited expanded history corpus and launch budget. An epoch must refer to actual retained data, not the old nominal horizon or repeats of the short HH-002 subset.

retention: Immutable HH-002 update-553 parent recovery state and provenance
Full stable pre-cooldown recovery state, including optimizer state, schedule/example counters, data cursor and RNG identity/state as required for reproducible continuation
Selected cooled evaluation models and compact validation/play evidence
before_launch: Implement and test a schedule-only Hero override and explicit checkpoint-fork contract; keep strict exact-resume checks intact.
Test warmup/stable/cooldown boundaries, horizon extension without warmup rescaling, and uninterrupted versus interrupted/resumed child-run equivalence.

Reconstruct and CPU-verify the remaining current/future full-history data, bind exclusions/order and the parent-to-expanded-data cursor mapping; never cycle the 553-update subset and call it a full original-data epoch.
Freeze source/input hashes, resolved recipe, seed, absolute cooldown boundaries, retention, common validation, W&B lineage and paired-play evaluation protocol in an immutable execution specification.
Refresh spend and projected storage, validate bounded stability at the sustained peak LR, and fit an approved compute budget. Existing Modal $34 stop / $42.50 outer limits remain unchanged.
interpretation: WSD is chosen for extendability, not because stronger chess play has been established. Relative to cosine it increases time at peak LR and changes cumulative updates/decoupled weight decay; report the schedule change in comparisons.
